description: An illicit nighttime street race held by the New Culture Collective that the Grand Prix grew out of.

timeline.summary: The Grand Prix begins decades before the New Phyrexian Invasion as the Ghirapur Sprint, an illicit street race held annually by the New Culture Collective.
timeline.quote: It was held at night annually by the New Culture Collective , a countercultural movement from Ghirapur.
